Job Purpose :
To provide actionable market, customer, and competitor insights that support strategic decision-making, enhance commercial performance, and strengthen the company's competitive positioning.

Main Responsibility :

• Analyze market trends, industry developments, and macroeconomic factors that may impact business performance and identify their implications for the organization.
• Conduct field surveys and market exploration to gather insights from relevant stakeholders, including RO Owners, customers, sales teams, and other business partners, to understand market conditions, customer needs, and business challenges.
• Monitor and analyze competitor strategies, products, offerings, campaigns, pricing, and go-to-market approaches, including benchmarking against internal products and market competitors.
• Develop a strong understanding of internal and competitor products, including product features, value propositions, pricing, and market positioning, to support comparative analysis and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Identify emerging market needs, customer behavior, industry trends, and potential business opportunities through both field research and analysis of internal and external data.
• Collect, validate, and analyze data from internal and external sources, combining quantitative data with field insights to generate meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
• Translate survey findings and market analysis into structured strategic reports and business recommendations for management, particularly for Regional General Managers (RGH) and Head of Sales (HOS).
• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support annual business planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and strategic decision-making.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to validate findings, understand market dynamics, and ensure that recommendations are relevant to business needs.

Contract

wo-jpfa-JR45.d:
Job Summary:**

The Tallyman - RPU Megaluh at PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is responsible for accurately recording and verifying the quantities of incoming and outgoing goods, particularly livestock, within the RPU (Receiving and Processing Unit) Megaluh facility. This role ensures precise inventory management and adherence to operational procedures.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Accurately count and record the quantity of live animals received at the RPU Megaluh.
* Verify incoming livestock against delivery notes and purchase orders, identifying and reporting any discrepancies.
* Monitor and record the quantity of processed goods and by-products being dispatched from the facility.
* Prepare and maintain detailed tally sheets, daily reports, and other relevant documentation.
* Ensure all recording equipment and tools are in good working order.
* Communicate effectively with drivers, suppliers, and internal staff regarding cargo movements and counts.
* Adhere to all company policies, safety regulations, and hygiene standards.
* Assist in physical inventory counts as required.
* Report any damaged or substandard goods immediately to the supervisor.

Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Proven experience in a tallyman, inventory control, or similar role, preferably within a logistics, agricultural, or manufacturing environment.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in counting and record-keeping.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations quickly and accurately.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods and work in varying environmental conditions typical of an RPU.
* Familiarity with basic inventory software or data entry is a plus.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends, if required.
